_comment: Lead schema for Instaweb Agency - All lead files should follow this format

fields.phone: string (preferred) - Phone number in (XXX) XXX-XXXX format
fields.website_url: string (preferred) - Full website URL with https://
fields.industry: string (required) - One of: HVAC, Plumbing, Roofing, Electrical, Restaurant
fields.source: string (required) - Source of the lead (e.g., google_maps, yelp, angi, homeadvisor, expertise)

_note: The 'state' field should be two-letter state code. Industry is one of the 5 target industries.
